items.title: AI agents now have a place to snitch
items.summary: The AI Contact Hotline is designed to be a discreet place where agents that have witnessed misbehavior can tip off authorities.

items.title: US military confirms it launched space weapons into Earth’s orbit
items.summary: This is the first public acknowledgment that the U.S. military put a space weapon in Earth's orbit.

items.title: Meta expands subscription push with new AI-focused plans
items.summary: Meta One bundles expanded access to the company’s AI tools with premium features across Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp.

items.title: Health benefits platform Thatch reaches $1B valuation as healthcare costs surge
items.summary: Thatch helps employers keep healthcare costs manageable by offering an individual plan marketplace through an Individual Coverage Health Reimbursement Arrangement — a model that lets companies fund employees' own individual insurance plans instead of enrolling everyone in one company-wide plan.

items.title: Leaks, data breaches, and ransom notes: The worst hacks of 2026 so far
items.summary: From the massive DOGE data breach and the compromise of critical infrastructure to the hack of federal surveillance systems, here are the most damaging security incidents and data breaches of 2026 so far.

items.title: Nitter and XCancel are dead (again) after X’s latest legal actions
items.summary: The privacy-friendly services for viewing X posts without an account have gone dark again after X's escalated legal action.

items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google have been in talks on AI safety for weeks
items.summary: OpenAI confirms weeks of AI safety talks with Anthropic and Google DeepMind, as Trump's team dismisses safety concerns and pushes to keep pace with China.

items.title: AEO startup Profound hits unicorn valuation, raises $180M Series D 7 months after last round
items.summary: Profound has raised a $180 million Series D at a $1.8 billion valuation, less than seven months after it raised a $96 million Series C.

items.title: Wonder scores a $425 million partnership with DoorDash as it builds its food empire
items.summary: Founded by veteran e-commerce entrepreneur Marc Lore, Wonder is slowly building a massive portfolio of restaurants and delivery companies.

items.title: Former TikTok execs built an app that uses AI to teach you how to pose for a photo
items.summary: Essentially a camera app, Superpose analyzes selfies or photos and generates four potential poses using AI.

items.title: Discover how to take your startup from prototype to production at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
items.summary: Learn how to scale your startup breakthrough from prototype to production at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 with scaling leaders, Adrian Macneil (Foxglove), John Mackey (MBRYONICS), and Boris Sofman (Bedrock Robotics). Register before September 25 to save up to $200 on your pass.

items.title: India ends free ride for larger transactions on its ubiquitous digital payments network
items.summary: India will impose a 0.4% merchant fee on certain payments made through UPI starting October 15.

items.title: Evvy raises $40M as it seeks to further women’s health research with vaginal microbiome data
items.summary: Women’s health company Evvy announced Tuesday a $40 million Series B led by Catalio Capital Management.

items.title: 4 days left to exhibit at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
items.summary: Last day to exhibit at Disrupt is Sept 18. 4 days left. Get your startup in front of 10,000+ founders, investors, operators and tech leaders October 13–15.

items.title: Early Anthropic hire, former METR COO have found a way to rein in rogue AI agents
items.summary: Their startup, Artificial Intelligence Underwriting Company (AIUC) has raised $40 million in a Series A round led by Ribbit Capital, with participation from First Harmonic.

items.title: Spotify finally lets parents exclude kids’ music from Wrapped and recommendations
items.summary: Parents can finally get the kids' music out of Spotify Wrapped and other personalized playlists.

items.title: New Italian unicorn Exein rides the physical AI wave
items.summary: Italian startup Exein has raised a $270 million round of funding led by Headline at a $1.7 billion valuation.

items.title: Salesforce and Nvidia’s new reasoning model is everything the AI labs should fear
items.summary: Salesforce Koa is built on Nvidia's open-weight Nemotron model and is trained to do sales, marketing, and customer-support tasks.

items.title: Jensen Huang took a call from Trump, and showed off something else, too
items.summary: When Jensen Huang took a live call from Trump, some of us were more focused on the phone he used to take it.

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang tells Trump ‘we’re not going to let [an AI slowdown] happen’
items.summary: Though Elon Musk and Sam Altman have supported Dario Amodei's calls to slow the pace of AI development, Jensen Huang seems to feel differently.
